heading: Quantum Computing Intelligence
subheading: Pure-plays, hedged giants & the road to commercial advantage
disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Quantum pure-plays trade at extreme valuations (P/S ~64–473×) and are highly speculative — position sizing matters more here than anywhere else on this hub. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Quantum technologies market projection; a Benchmark analyst puts 2026 industry revenue at only ~$1.5B.

DARPA moved IonQ, IBM, Atom Computing and Diraq into the final QBI stage on Oct 7 (IonQ's deal is worth up to $300M through 2029), and NVIDIA pledged $1B over five years to US science including quantum (Oct 8). Shares still slid on a bond rout (10-year yield briefly 5.36%, a 2002 high): IonQ −8.9% to $39.89, Rigetti −8.0% to $14.03, D-Wave −7.6% to $14.57, Quantinuum −10.4% to $41.30 (new 52-week low) and Pasqal +13.2% to $6.85, versus QTUM −2.6% to $152.06.

IonQ's full-year 2026 guidance (raised Sep 17) leans heavily on the SkyWater foundry acquisition (closed Jul 31). Q2 revenue was $80.05M (+287% YoY) with a $1.87B GAAP net loss, largely a $1.6B warrant fair-value charge. On guidance, forward price-to-sales is roughly 35× versus ~64× trailing.

IonQ $39.89 (~$15.85B mkt cap / $246.5M TTM revenue, P/S ~64×) / Rigetti $14.03 (~$4.68B / $13.35M, P/S ~350×) / D-Wave $14.57 (~$5.43B / $12.43M, down 44% YoY, P/S ~437×) / Quantinuum $41.30 (~$10.87B / $22.97M, P/S ~473×); Pasqal $6.85 (~$1.45B mkt cap); Defiance Quantum ETF (QTUM) $152.06 (~$5.70B AUM), below its 52-week high of $170

tiers.label: Hedged Giants — Quantum as an Option
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list. Most quantum systems remain in R&D; true commercial systems are likely years away.

rows.angle: Oct 7: DARPA moved IBM into QBI Stage C (final stage) alongside IonQ, Atom Computing and Diraq, joining Microsoft and PsiQuantum; builds on Nighthawk r2, Anderon CHIPS foundry funding and new India research ties
rows.watch for: Stage C award size (not disclosed); Albany 300mm foundry yield ramp; progress against the 2029 fault-tolerant Starling roadmap

rows.angle: No new hardware headline since the Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone (a logical qubit outlasting its physical qubits); still a lab result, and Google is not among the Stage C additions
rows.watch for: Scaling stable logical qubits into larger arrays; any commercial Willow-class access; overlap with your AI-sleeve Alphabet exposure

rows.angle: Majorana 2 sits with DARPA for independent testing at the new Maryland center; Microsoft and PsiQuantum were already in QBI Stage C before this week's four additions
rows.watch for: Independent test results on the topological-qubit claims; Quantinuum partnership developments

rows.angle: Oct 8: committed $1B over five years to US science (AI, quantum, healthcare, energy) and is a Phase 2 Genesis Mission collaborator; CUDA-Q and NVQLink tie quantum hardware to GPU systems
rows.watch for: How much of the $1B reaches quantum; new NVQLink adopters; quantum remains immaterial to NVIDIA's revenue

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Reached DARPA QBI Stage C earlier (with Microsoft; $125M award Jul 23, up to $300M) and finalized a $100M CHIPS R&D award on Sep 8. Valued around $10.5B privately (~$1.5B round, May 2026) and building its Moreton Bay facility in Australia.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Now public and at a 52-week low ($41.30, ~$10.9B market cap). The $100M CHIPS award and Oracle/Quanta deals have not lifted the shares; see Tier 2. Carried here for the private-to-public context.

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: Previously reported 96 verified logical qubits and a DARPA QBI Stage B slot (not re-verified this week); not among the Oct 7 Stage C additions. Neutral atoms stay in focus: Atom Computing joined Stage C and Infleqtion (now listed as INFQ) announced 30 entangled logical qubits on Sep 24 using error detection, not correction.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: IonQ's $15.9B market cap sits on $246.5M of trailing revenue, and roughly half of its FY26 guidance is inorganic (SkyWater). D-Wave's trailing revenue is $12.43M, down 44% YoY; Quantinuum booked about $8M last quarter and says customers must prove business cases first.

bear_case.title: Rates are the swing factor
bear_case.description: The 10-year yield briefly hit 5.36% on Oct 7, a 2002 high, and Fed minutes still weigh another hike. Pre-revenue long-duration names sold off even on good news: IonQ fell ~9% on the week despite a DARPA Stage C award, and Quantinuum is down ~10% to a new low.

bear_case.title: Drawdowns remain brutal
bear_case.description: IonQ is ~53% below its 52-week high, Rigetti's market cap is down ~67% over the year, and D-Wave's market cap is down ~54%, trading within ~14% of its $12.75 low. Quantinuum printed a fresh low this week.

bear_case.title: Dilution and government ownership
bear_case.description: Commerce is taking minority, non-controlling equity stakes alongside $100M CHIPS awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum, and IonQ's Q2 carried a $1.6B warrant fair-value charge that drove a $1.87B GAAP loss. DARPA Stage C money is 'up to' and subject to appropriations.

bear_case.title: The winner may not be listed or pure-play
bear_case.description: Microsoft, IBM, PsiQuantum, Atom Computing and Diraq sit in QBI Stage C alongside IonQ; PsiQuantum, Atom and Diraq are private and two are giants where quantum is a rounding error. Rigetti, D-Wave and Quantinuum are not on the list. Headline milestones can also oversell: Infleqtion's 30 logical qubits rely on error detection, not correction.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: IBM
positions.note: Entered DARPA QBI Stage C on Oct 7 on top of the Albany 300mm foundry and Anderon CHIPS funding; steady execution at a valuation that does not depend on quantum.

positions.name: Alphabet
positions.note: Sep 22 logical-qubit stability milestone remains a top technical result among hedged names, though Google was not among the Oct 7 Stage C additions; also a large AI-sleeve holding, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: Microsoft
positions.note: In DARPA QBI Stage C since before this week and Majorana 2 is under independent DARPA testing; the topological claims are still contested, and MSFT also sits in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.note: Picks-and-shovels via CUDA-Q and NVQLink, plus a $1B five-year US science commitment (Oct 8); quantum is immaterial to its revenue and it is also in the AI sleeve, so avoid double-counting.

positions.name: IonQ
positions.note: DARPA Stage C (up to $300M through 2029) and a raised $450–460M guidance are real, but ~64× trailing sales, a $1.6B warrant charge and a ~9% weekly drop to $39.89 keep it speculative.

positions.name: Rigetti
positions.note: $14.03 and ~350× sales on only $13.35M of TTM revenue; the $100M CHIPS award brings a government equity stake (dilution) and it missed the Oct 7 Stage C additions.

positions.name: Quantinuum
positions.note: New 52-week low of $41.04 after ~$8M of quarterly revenue and an EPS miss, at ~473× trailing sales; credible technology but the price and lockup overhang say wait.

positions.name: D-Wave
positions.note: Trailing revenue of $12.43M is down 44% YoY against a ~$5.43B market cap and a $248.7M net loss; partnership announcements this week do not change the case.

positions.name: Pasqal
positions.note: Bounced 13% to $6.85 on a StoneX Buy initiation but still sits near its $5.90 low with 14% H1 revenue growth; wait for its first reported quarter as a listed company.
